patches.name: Keyword content filter (Enhanced)
patches.description: Upgrades the Morphe keyword content filter with visible-text protobuf extraction, Regex, AND ('&') operator, case-insensitive matching, channel filtering, subtitle keyword scanner, and debug mode.

patches.name: Voice Over Translation (Yandex)
patches.description: Adds an option to enable Yandex voice-over translation of video audio tracks. Requires a Morphe Patches version with add-on support.
